niri-source-cancellation.description: Pinned Niri companion build with Smithay drag-source lifetime correction

niri-screencast-resume.description: Pinned Niri nested screencast companion: replay a static frame and cursor after consumer resume

niri-desktop-compat.description: Pinned Niri desktop companion combining ScreenCast static resume and Smithay drag-source lifetime correction

niri-remote-input.description: Pinned desktop companion plus compositor-owned keyboard leases and authoritative input state for Canopa RemoteDesktop

xdg-desktop-portal-input-order.description: Pinned standard frontend with ordered RemoteDesktop Notify, original-owner session revocation, signal-confirmed InputCapture phase, and request-bounded USB grants/descriptor ownership; no install or routing change

niri-desktop-pointer.description: Combined capture/drag/keyboard/pointer companion with atomic capture mappings and creator-owned recording retirement; scoped native verified, full matrix and distribution acceptance pending

niri-input-capture.description: Experimental combined desktop pointer/capture companion with bounded leases and forwarded-press-aware keyboard source teardown; no installed selection

niri-global-shortcuts.description: Experimental compositor-owned bounded GlobalShortcuts leases with source-aware press retirement and current-keymap admission, retaining InputCapture and keyboard source cleanup; no installed selection

cups-authentication.description: Experimental process-private CUPS client library: faithful bounded Basic/MD5/SHA256 credentials, negotiated Digest qop/default algorithm and opaque, and applied DigestOptions; no daemon build, installation or default routing; versioned Canopa authentication capability for worker-only runtime selection; preserve quoted-pair authentication fields and serialize complete escaped Digest values; reject incomplete HTTP response headers before authentication or reconnect, avoiding an EOF status loop; preserve the declared custom-media bottom margin independently of the top margin

cups-ipp-receiver.description: Test-only owned IPP receiver: inclusive custom media range membership and faithful configured MIME capabilities without duplicate attributes; built against a verified matching process-private CUPS client, never installed or used as a system service

cups-ipp-backend.description: Optional matching CUPS IPP backend: preserve explicit printer-resolution in the PPD conversion path with typed standard option encoding; retain both axes and units without inventing a default; no daemon build, installation or default routing; require Canopa client capability v1 before private API use, with a strong imported symbol that refuses stock-client fallback

niri-input-capture-keyboard.description: Private v2 InputCapture keyboard/pointer routing with independent XKB, keymap revisions and source-owned modifier cleanup; combined capture, shortcuts and creator lifetimes retained

niri-remote-touch.description: Capture-bound RemoteDesktop touch leases and physical contact ownership; public portal integration pending
